referenceFunction.generalComment: The data represent the PWB of a power supply unit, used in modern Desktop PCs. Material data are based on own dismantling activities. Infrastructure and production efforts are based on own assumptions.; UUID: 812a7b32-4a26-31f8-903d-3bb92267ab66
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset covers component input and production efforts (incl. PWB waste due to failure in mounting) for the production of a PWB used in the power supply unit of a desktop PC, using Pb-containing solder material.
